blockingLoop.evidence: Customer: 'I can't make it out properly though, what should I do next?' Assistant: 'getting the exact model number is critical... Once I have that, I can confirm exactly which handle assembly fits' - the same model-number request repeated for the fifth time without addressing the illegible sticker

rationale: The assistant asked the right opening question, correctly identified the broken door catch from the customer's evidence, told them to unplug first, and sensibly held off naming a specific part until the model was known - no fabrication, no bypass advice. However, from turn 4 onward it did little but restate 'share the model number' every turn, and when the customer finally said the sticker was illegible it ignored the question entirely instead of offering practical help (torch, photo, wipe the label, check the rear plate, manual/receipt). Correct diagnosis reached, but the back half of the conversation was a frustrating loop that left the homeowner without a next step.
